subtitle: Lesson 6 · Chapter 1: The First Support Ticket Report

code:
CREATE ROLE IF NOT EXISTS
  DRIFTWOOD_SUPPORT_ANALYST;
caption: A role on its own has zero privileges until you GRANT something to it.

eyebrow: The grant chain: USAGE, every level
caption: Missing any one of these three breaks the whole chain, regardless of the final object.

steps.label: Granted in Lesson 7
steps.sub: SELECT on the view, once it exists

eyebrow: Assigning the role to a person
code:
GRANT ROLE DRIFTWOOD_SUPPORT_ANALYST
  TO USER SUPPORT_ANALYST_USER;
caption: The person opening the Power BI report connects with this role, not an admin role.

subtitle: Creating the object this role's final GRANT SELECT will point to.
